title: occ/{occ}/collection payload
description: UPSERT payload of occ/{occ}/collection: the collection the copy is filed in. Shown only when that collection exists and its kind is the copy's status; otherwise the copy shows in {status}/default. A DELETE files it back in the default. Serialized, at most 183 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

collection.description: A collection ref, "{kind}/{cid|default}": kind owned | ordered | wished | former, cid a lowercase dashed uuid.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
